steps.name: Install nltk (five suites reach the POS tagger through features.py)
Install numpy (rhyme_organization's conditional nulls are vectorised)
Stage the tagger model and the concreteness norms

The 96 cheap suites (comparator_pin joined 2026-09-17 with the comparator pin, added in the same commit as the module it gates so it never joins the orphan census below -- the gate exists because six PRs moved `lyric_harness.py` in one day on 2026-09-16 and the only instrument that noticed was the most expensive one in the tree, which noticed late and on somebody else's commit; its five sections all MUTATE, because a pin that always says HOLDS reads exactly like a pin that works, label 95 to 96; interlocking_chain joined for M-40; melody joined 2026-09-16 with I-1's melody-first entrance -- the suite shipped in that lot WITHOUT this line, and test_verbs 24's orphan census caught it in CI rather than anybody reading the diff, which is the same shape it has caught every other time a suite arrived without its ci.yml line; rhyme_organization joined 2026-09-15 with the L-1/L-2 conditional-null redesign, exact orbits and unsupported timing refusal; stub_resolution joined 2026-09-15 for A-1 full chorus blocks; tempo joined 2026-09-15 for C-5 declared elapsed-time conversion; computational_audit joined 2026-09-14 with the lyrics computational audit -- 24 unittest cases over the corrected occurrence, boundary and Sidak arithmetic, 6.4 s -- caught by test_verbs §24's orphan census on the audit's own PR, the same shape it has caught every time a suite arrived without its ci.yml line, label 89 to 90; within_item joined 2026-09-10 with M-270's subclass-aware concreteness-norm gate, in the same commit as the fix — the within-item extractor's three norm-backed features had been NaN on every item for two days behind a green tree, because the one suite that would have said so is cold and heavy and lives outside this job; floor_window, capacity_receipt and candidate_pair_projection joined 2026-09-08 for the per-line query cost regression; production_data, production_harness, production_journal, production_relations and production_revision joined 2026-09-08 for the production audit repairs; audit_regressions joined 2026-09-07 for verification identity, coverage and durable proposal replay; propose + verify_entries joined 2026-08-15; nc_census + plan + meter_bands 2026-08-17; homeoteleuton + structures in, verbs out to its own sharded job, structure_census with its artifact, screen with the no-private-instruments rule, capacity with the density design's stage 1, 2026-08-18; corpus_taxonomy with the region/function axes and the calibration manifest, 2026-08-19; expected_drift with the declared-drift ruling and data_row_claims with the re-derived provenance numbers, 2026-08-21; pin_sweep + suite_sweep 2026-08-22 — both were ORPHANS, found by the very check in test_verbs.py that exists because a list that is short looks exactly like a list that is complete; mandate_relation + relation_shapes + relations_null 2026-08-22, the SAME check catching the same shape a second time in one day — three suites written during the relation-ladder work and never added here, so every one of them was green on a developer machine and unrun in CI; placement 2026-08-22 with the section-constraint layer, added in the same commit as the suite rather than after somebody noticed; section_marks the same day with the bracketed-mark triage, whose own `--check` is the gate that a corpus load printing a NEW mark turns red instead of joining the 62% that answered nothing; slots 2026-08-23 with the placement coordinate and recover the same day with the second door into the pipeline, each added in the same commit as the module it gates so neither joins the census below; capabilities 2026-08-23 — the SAME orphan census a third time, and this one had been unrun since the day it was written — `quality/test_capabilities.py` §8 is what pins the 77-of-77-askable claim CLAUDE.md leads with, 51 checks at 6.9s, named by nothing that gates; gate_census 2026-08-23 with the census of which findings can refuse anything, added in the same commit as the module it gates — and the instrument's own first run is why it is here rather than a sitting later: it named two constructors, measured 46 codes, and omitted `quality/grid.py`'s SHAPE layer entirely, which a census reports as fully gated; songs 2026-08-24 — the DELIVERED songs, which until that day nothing in this repository read at all: zero checks under quality/, zero mentions here, and two of the five had shipped with their section structure missing while every gate in the tree stayed green; render_form the same day — the check that reads a MESSAGE, which no other gate can, plus the Stop hook that hands it the transcript and BLOCKS a turn carrying a section bracket with its apparatus stripped; songs_record the same day — the SERIES, because every report about these songs had been a PASS/FAIL bit read aloud as a judgement, and its claim check is the one gate in this tree aimed at the narrator rather than the code; songs_log the same day — the PROCESS beside the product, because the series banks what a song IS and nothing banked how it got there, and the zero-ceiling rhyme families were a markdown table no command could re-derive; sentencehood 2026-08-25 with the M-110 noun-stack layer — the nightly gained `sentencehood.py --check` in the same commit as the module and its SUITE joined nothing, the census's own defect one more time, caught by the census; narrative 2026-08-25 — the paired blind experiment's own suite, written across the M-121 narrative-layer sittings and never added here, and the census's finding was MASKED for a day: the orphan check is test_verbs §24, shard 1 died at §20's M-116 breakage two sections in front of it, so a crash in one section hid an orphan in another — the fix that cleared the crash is what let the census speak; door_census 2026-08-26 with the M-139 census of which DOOR each pair-satisfaction site judges at, added in the same commit as the module it gates -- and this label went from 71 to 72 with it, which `test_verbs.py` §43's own check is what caught: the label a reader trusts must equal the list it labels, and a suite added without moving the number is a list that is short looking exactly like a list that is complete; chance_rate 2026-08-26 with M-138's strike and M-140 -- the chance-rate measurement had by then been improvised TWICE from uncommitted scripts, which standing rule 3 calls a defect report, and its suite is here in the same commit as the module so it never joins the orphan census above; verify_figures 2026-08-28 with M-33's live/history citation instrument, added the sitting after its module -- the orphan census caught it on the full test_verbs run, the same shape a fourth time, and the label moved 73 to 74 with it; replay_memo 2026-08-29 with M-167's deferred-replay grading memo — the warm worker's cross-request answer to the quadratic resume cost round 9 measured, added in the same commit as the module it gates, label 74 to 75; staging 2026-09-01 with the retried, atomic staged download -- run #1195 lost a whole CI run to one TLS reset in a step that had not begun any test, and the `suites` shard matrix in this same commit took the number of jobs performing that unretried download from 5 to 8 per run, so the sharding made the failure MORE likely and this is the cost being paid rather than deferred, label 75 to 76; ban_convergence 2026-09-02 with the ban-against-the-bank instrument (M-168, triage C18), added in the same commit as the module it gates — its 13 checks re-derive one song's README triple through `Reviser.inspect` and kill a one-word mutation, ~2 min, label 76 to 77; cross_song 2026-09-02 with the cross-song disclosure M-111's ruling built (triage C08), added in the same commit as the module it gates — the section that earns its place is the PREFIX PIN, which holds `screen` output as a byte prefix of `screen --bank` and so makes the GATE the ruling refused mechanically unreachable rather than merely discouraged; the null half of the pin costs ~60s of corpus tagging and is `cross_song.py --check`'s business, which pin_sweep discovers by itself, label 77 to 78; brief_provenance 2026-09-02 with the gate on WHETHER A REVISION WAS BRIEFED (M-200), added in the same commit as the module it gates — the loop had been computing a complete OFFERED field per bound position, excluding both ban tiers, and nothing required a writer to read it, so a session hand-guessed five replacement pairs across three `finish` runs and every one came back BANNED; the check that earns its place is the FINGERPRINT one, which makes a brief earned on one draft unable to launder a hand-edit made to another, label 78 to 79; plan + capacity OUT to their own dealt matrix jobs and shard IN — the one dealing-and-timing idiom every dealt suite now calls — 2026-09-05 (M-244), label 79 to 78; battery_rounds 2026-09-06 with the one-row-per-round battery table and its closed layer vocabulary (M-254 D), added in the same commit as the module it gates — six checks, under a second, label 78 to 79)
Song-profile calibration, against the drift that is RULED (not silenced)
Meter-band adoption check, the shipped constants re-derived
Span-search null, the shipped band against the measured crossover
Door census, every pair-satisfaction site against the 77
Chance rate, the shipped door against random pairs
